fields.value: Approximately 34 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). The three retained positive tips are approximately evenly spaced within this limited window. Slow repeated negative-positive complexes with multiple small pointed intercomplex bumps at apparently repeating intervals. Recurring intercomplex candidates support checking for a separate atrial sequence, but do not preferentially establish AV conduction disturbance or dissociation. Slow conducted rhythms, escape mechanisms and nonatrial contours remain alternatives; distinguishing them requires identified atrial events and their actual relationship to ventricular events. Slow roughly regular retained complexes near 34 coexist with multiple recurring small intercomplex candidates. These are not yet true P waves; atrial regularity, count and independent P-QRS relationships are unproved. Three complete examples and an incomplete edge event limit the sample. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and establishes no narrow/wide or normal/abnormal class. PR remains withheld.
